content_metadata.description: The video follows the journey of female boxer Skye Nicholson as she overcomes doubt, negativity, and challenges to become a champion. Her story is one of resilience, determination, and proving doubters wrong.

text_to_speech: They said I'd never box like my brother. They said I'd never make it past the first round. They said I'd never cut it as a pro. Never make it to the top. Never mix it. Never hack it. Never win, win...win again. Win a World Title. They said I was just an Instagram boxer. Never fought anyone good. Undefeated WBC Interim  Featherweight Champion of the world. Go on, tell me what I'll never do next!
